The '''Crash Site Cavern''' is a cave located a very short distance north of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. It is visited during [[Monkey Madness II]], where the final battle is fought. It remains accessible after completing the quest, after talking to Steve, where it is inhabited by [[tortured gorilla|tortured]] and [[demonic gorilla]]s, which drop the components used to create the [[light ballista|light]] and [[heavy ballista]], as well as [[zenyte shard]]s used to create [[zenyte jewellery]].

Outside the cavern are the remains of [[Glough]]'s airship along with [[Assistant Le Smith]]'s remains. A [[crate (Crash Site)|crate]] near the cavern entrance can be searched to obtain a [[Monkey (Monkey Madness II)|monkey]], which is worn in the cape slot. The monkey will return to this crate if lost in any way.

Upon entering the cavern entrance, two messages will appear in the chat box stating {{Mes|You enter the cavern beneath the crash site.}} and {{Mes|Why would you want to go in there?}}.

The caverns consist of both single and multi-way combat zones, with the singles zone being just ahead of the archway near the two demonic gorillas in the single-way area. A path near the exit rope in the caves leads to a large area filled with demonic gorillas in single-way combat. Past this archway, the entire area is exclusively multi-way. Gorillas killed in the multi-way zones will broadcast their drop within the nearby vicinity.

==Transportation==
The entrance to the Crash Site Cavern may be found north-west of the [[Grand Tree]] through the opening in the fence. Once through the fence run north-east to enter the cavern.

There are a few ways to get to the Grand Tree from which you can run to the cavern.

* Use the [[royal seed pod]]'s teleport option which takes you to the base of the Grand Tree. This is the fastest travel option.
* Use a [[Spirit tree]] to the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold|Gnome stronghold]] and run north and then north-west to the gap in the fence.
* Use the [[Gnome glider]] to '''Ta Quir Priw''' which will take you to the top of the Grand Tree. Descend the tree and run north-west to the gap in the fence.

==Trivia==
*When entering the area outside the entrance to the caves, the player is put into an [[instance]]d zone regardless if the quest is completed or not. Prior to completing the quest, this area is filled with aggressive tortured gorillas, who no longer appear once the quest is completed.
*At the entrance to the caves, there are three skeletal remains that appear to be that of demonic gorillas, although this contradicts their [[Malicious ashes|ash]] remains when the player kills them. Likewise, [[Assistant Le Smith]]'s skeletal remains resemble more of an unknown humanoid rather than that of a gnome.
